Coram : M.R. SHAH*, M.M. SUNDRESH
Service Law: Regularisation in service – Continuity of service for a longer period on a contractual basis – Regularization sought on basis thereof – Held: Merely because employee-driver continued in service for longer period on contractual basis, the order of have passed more particularly, when a policy decision was taken to avail the services of the driver by the agency/contractor and that the appointment of employee and other similarly situated drivers was not made after any selection procedure – Appointment of the employee was purely on
